repos_data.description: MCP server that lets AI agents query SQL databases in natural language - read-only, with column masking, row caps, and query limits. SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL.
MCP server for SQLite — query databases, inspect schemas, explain queries
Read-only MCP server for querying PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite from AI agents — multi-database, safe by default.

An MCP server that provides safe, read-only access to SQLite databases through Model Context Protocol (MCP). This server is built with the FastMCP framework, which enables LLMs to explore and query SQLite databases with built-in safety features and query validation.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables natural language queries to databases
A MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for interacting with dbt.
An official Qdrant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation

A local [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (MCP) server that lets an LLM — e.g. Claude Desktop — query your personal health and finance data. Everything is stored in two local SQLite files and read directly off disk by a Python process you control. No cloud database, no dashboard, no third-party service.
MCP server for Nile Database - Manage and query databases, tenants, users, auth using LLMs
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables secure interaction with MySQL databases

repo_meta_data.description: An MCP server (and a CLI) that lets an LLM query your databases in natural language through a business semantic layer — glossary, metric definitions, data dictionary, knowledge base, and example queries — grounded against your real schema.
